column1: From the old part of town to the mountains
To pick mushrooms & herbs as a child
To an enchanted forest in a magic time
Where a child could grow up wild
& The mountains were filled up with snipers
As bright as the stars in the sky
Our one line of defense was the forests & fields
Where we'd plant our mines for them to reap
The only way out was a coffin
You can't feed your child on resistance & pride
We were just out of supplies
We reclaimed the squares & the sidewalks
Taught the children to play in the sun
But to not run & hide in the forests & fields
Where the mines won't be cleared
From the old part of town to the mountains
That used to be 90% of our industry
Where my son works full time
Since the day my grandson became a memory
